arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The government advocate stated the non-citizens failed to attend hearings after receiving written notice.
The non-citizen advocate stated the government repeatedly asks to be relieved of consequences for flouting the statute.
The government advocate argued Pereira does not resolve the current statutory question.
The non-citizen advocate argued ordinary English speakers do not use change to mean indeterminate to determinate time.
